{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows low positive sentiment (e.g., 0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent true outcomes show sharp downward drift after a spike.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices (last 3-5 days) when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast is >15% above recent 10-day average, reduce by 10-20%.",
    "If sentiment history includes a 0.67 or higher value, increase forecast volatility by 5-10% to reflect bullish momentum.",
    "For horizon >15 days, apply lag correction: reduce forecast by 2-5% for each day beyond 10-day horizon if no sentiment support.",
    "When true outcome is significantly below forecast (e.g., >10% under), assume model overconfident and adjust downward by 5-15%.",
    "If sentiment history shows a 0.33 or higher, consider upward bias correction: add 3-7% to forecast if recent prices are trending up."
  ]
}
